patch_description: The current ansatz only has a single-axis (RY) input mixer, whereas the best-performing prior (0.98) uses two axes (RY+RX). Additionally, all 28 CZ gates commute and effectively form a single diagonal unitary regardless of ordering. By splitting the CZ block into two halves and inserting a collective two-axis mixer (RY+RX) between them, we break this commutativity, creating a much richer unitary that can capture more complex feature interactions. This adds only 2 shared parameters (mid_ry, mid_rx) beyond the proven 4-parameter structure, totaling 6 params per block (38 total). The increased expressivity should push validation accuracy higher and reduce loss, outweighing any parameter efficiency penalty.
